WITH long_rental_films AS (
  SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration
  FROM film
  WHERE rental_duration > 5
),
per_rating_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_rate_per_duration,
    COUNT(*) as film_count
  FROM long_rental_films
  WHERE rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_duration) as benchmark_value
  FROM per_rating_avgs
)
SELECT 
  p.rating,
  p.avg_rate_per_duration,
  p.film_count,
  p.avg_rate_per_duration / b.benchmark_value as ratio
FROM per_rating_avgs p
CROSS JOIN benchmark b
WHERE b.benchmark_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.rating
